title: Test engram_bootstrap_config_read_has_a_fixed_deadline_despite_sibling_activity intermittently leaves its state directory in the test run root, failing the Rust stage with all tests passing
outcome: The test cleans up after itself on every run, whatever the load, so the full gate's Rust stage never fails on a green test run because of leftover temp entries.
acceptance: The writer that recreates the state directory after teardown is identified with evidence from the retained run root or a discriminating test.
The fixture joins or stops that writer before removing its state, and a test drives the late-write timing and asserts the run root is left empty; no retry, quarantine or timeout increase.
